definition.name: Compare exact old and new parsers on retained original preview

steps.name: Check fixed event, member and observation boundaries
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_wac_threading_probe -v

steps.name: Acquire the fixed WAC 0.11.0 diagnostic tool
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-wac-threading"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wac/releases/download/v0.11.0/wac-cli-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-wac-threading/wac-0.11.0"
printf '%s  %s\n' 83259349b630f79a60490322b068e7ad2dba784720b0d467decccc0aecc743b5 "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-wac-threading/wac-0.11.0" | sha256sum --check --strict
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-wac-threading/wac-0.11.0")" -eq 22917648
chmod 0700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-wac-threading/wac-0.11.0"

steps.name: Compare the exact retained preview without rebuilding or guest execution
Retain bounded parser outcomes and public components

with.name: rust-wac-threading-probe-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/logs/*.stdout.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/logs/*.stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/preview.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/new.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-wac-threading/result/identity.wac

reviewReason: Authenticate the failed original artifact and both pinned tools; retain exact outcomes without claiming full composition.
